title: USGS Releases Assessment of Undiscovered Oil and Gas Resources in Buda Limestone of Texas
description: RESTON, Va. — The U.S. Geological Survey released its assessment of undiscovered gas and oil in the Buda Limestone formation near the Texas Gulf Coast, assessing that there are technically recoverable resources of 184 billion cubic feet of gas and 12 million barrels of oil.

subtitle: U.S. Geological Survey · Jun 24, 2026

title: USGS: Lithium in Carolinas Could Replace Imports for a Century or More
description: RESTON, Va. — The southern Appalachian region of the eastern United States contains an estimated 1.43 million metric tons of undiscovered, economically recoverable lithium oxide, enough to replace 201 years of U.S. imports at last year’s level, according to new research by the U.S. Geological Survey.
